items.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. ONE original wide 16:9 introduction illustration for a Japanese first-year junior-high lesson on practicing Japanese writing and learning about kinds of writing. Three Japanese junior-high students in plain uniforms sit together at a classroom desk, getting ready to practice with pencils, a writing brush resting on a clean mat, completely BLANK paper, and a few cards that contain only simple pictures of a tree and a mountain. One holds a pencil just above the paper, another thoughtfully compares the picture cards, and a third discusses them. This is a scene of preparation and learning, NOT a diagram explaining letter origins. Do not invent pseudo-characters or etymologies. All paper, cards apart from the small tree/mountain pictures, books and background must have NO letters, Japanese/Chinese characters, numerals, writing-like marks, grid labels, logos or watermark. Soft warm hand-drawn watercolor/flat educational style, rounded expressive faces, muted blue/green/orange, clean simple classroom, clear central activity. Single finished image, no variants.

items.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. ONE original wide 16:9 Japanese junior-high textbook scene introducing children's rights. A diverse group of children and young teens from different backgrounds stand in ONE clear closed circle, holding hands and smiling warmly, with two Japanese junior-high students in plain uniforms among them. Skin tones, hair and ordinary clothing vary naturally without national costumes or stereotypes. Include a child using a wheelchair as an equal participant in the circle with hands linked to neighbors. Communicate every child's dignity, inclusion, living and growing together through the scene, no written slogans or lessons. Simple sunny park background, clear readable hand links and human anatomy, friendly rounded hand-painted educational style, muted blue/green/orange. No flags, national labels, text, letters, numbers, logos, watermark, famous character designs, copied book illustration, violence or frightening expressions.
